sons.prompt: Instrumental soundtrack for a 23-second premium SaaS product film. Dark, elegant, modern electronic: warm analog pad, soft sub bass, delicate plucked synth arpeggio, tight minimal percussion, glassy bell accents. D minor resolving to F major, 86 BPM. Structure: 0 to 3 seconds, quiet atmospheric intro with one warm bell-like chord swell at second 1, no drums. 3 to 9 seconds, a soft pulsing arpeggio enters with a light kick heartbeat, building gently. 9 to 12.5 seconds, tension, drums thin out, filter rising. At 12.5 seconds, a satisfying deep impact with a bright shimmering chord and the track opens up. 12.5 to 20 seconds, fuller confident uplifting groove, widest from 17 to 20 seconds. 20 to 23 seconds, everything resolves into one long warm final chord that fades out with a clean ending. No vocals. Cinematic, polished, tech product launch mood, never aggressive.
